messages:
alex_sales: Quick question — prospect wants a 6-week POC with strict EU-only data paths. They asked for our sub-processor list, whether we can pin routing to eu-west-1, and BYOK/KMS options. Any blockers on pricing or timeline?

nisha_presales: Short answer: doable but depends on deployment mode. Dedicated or Private = strict pinning. Hosted = region affinity but control plane may still be outside EU. Tagging @omar_solutions and @lisa_security to confirm the ops/security constraints. :mag:

omar_solutions: We can tenant-pin on Dedicated. For Hosted we can prefer eu-west-1 but cannot legally guarantee zero egress to control plane. For strict EU-only you need Private (control plane in customer VPC) or Dedicated with EU-only standby. Cost delta expected.

lisa_security: From security/compliance: we need a signed sub-processor addendum and possibly SCCs depending on customer jurisdiction. BYOK requires KMS/HSM integration — legal will want specific contract language. We can provide a redacted subprocessor list for presales.

alex_sales: Customer also asks about DR/failover: can we do hot-standby in EU only? They also want SOC2 report and a vuln scan on the POC infra.

omar_solutions: Yes, hot-standby in EU is possible but adds cost. For a lightweight POC we typically run single-AZ in eu-west-1 and set a manual routing policy to prevent cross-region failover. Example snippet for the POC routing policy (handy for the SOW):

```
routing_policy: {"primary": "eu-west-1", "failover": "none"}
```

That pins traffic to EU for the POC; for production we recommend a tested failover plan.

lisa_security: We can share SOC2 + ISO artifacts via secure link. For vuln scans: we can schedule a snapshot scan; need eng-infra signoff. @tim_ops can coordinate.

tim_ops: I can run the scan — need a contact email and a maintenance window (1 hour) during the POC. BYOK: for Private, customer should provide the KMS in their VPC. For Dedicated we can do tenant-managed keys with a one-time onboarding flow.

alex_sales: Pricing — can you ballpark a 6-week POC with Dedicated + EU standby + BYOK onboarding so I can put numbers into the SOW?

omar_solutions: Ballpark (very rough): Dedicated baseline ~$8k/week (reserved GPUs + support), EU standby ~$2k/week, BYOK onboarding one-time ~$5k, vuln scans + compliance docs ~$1k. So ~ $57k for 6 weeks. I'll sync with finance for exact numbers and discounts.

nisha_presales: I'll draft an ops checklist and presales notes (subprocessor release, KMS flow, scan window). Also looping legal for the subprocessor addendum. Alex — can you grab the customer point of contact and their timeline and drop it here?

alex_sales: Sent intro to customer (cc'd their infra lead). I'll push timeline (they want kickoff next Monday). Expect an initial SOW draft from me by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Ticket created: POC-1234 — presales ops checklist and security intake created.
